title: oreogeum bulgaricum
intro: Oreogeum bulgaricum, commonly known as Bulgarian angelica, is a perennial plant in the carrot family native to Bulgaria. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in the treatment of various conditions, such as digestive issues and stress relief. The therapeutic actions of Bulgarian angelica include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and acting as an antiseptic and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
